name: career-map
description: A read-only canvas of an employee's career plan — role cards joined by routes coloured by role: the followed company path green, other company paths grey, Career visions dashed violet. Clicking a line selects its whole route.

states.targetSelected: career-map/node-selected, outline flush with the border (no offset)

edges.arrowhead: ~10px fixed (marker 40 in screen units), same at every stroke width

controls.buttonSize: Button size icon (matches the toolbar's control height)

legend.button: Button outline size sm — one per route drawn on the map
legend.swatch: the route's role colour — strong when active, -inactive otherwise (20×3px)

properties.value: The map is a group with the consumer's aria-label (e.g. "Lan Nguyen's career map").

Every card is focusable with Tab and announces its state, Position and level ("Active target: Backend Engineer, L3 · Senior"). Enter or Space selects it; the description says so. Delete does nothing — the map is read-only.

Colour shows a route's role, not its identity: the followed path is green and named "· you follow" in the legend, every other company path is grey, Career visions are dashed as well as violet. The legend names each route. The active route (the selected one, or the followed path when nothing is selected) is thicker, uses its role's strong token and rings its cards — not colour alone. Other routes use the role's -inactive token. On the canvas, active: followed 4.2:1, other path 6.4:1, vision 3.5:1. Inactive lines (1.5–2.1:1) are below 3:1 by design; the legend names every route at full text contrast.

Opening view never shrinks cards below 70% zoom so text stays readable. When the whole map doesn't fit at that zoom, it opens on the current role and its next steps; "Show whole map" zooms out. Page scroll is never captured — scroll-to-zoom is off.
Zoom out, Zoom in and Show whole map are design-system Buttons with accessible names.
Freeform canvases are hard to use by keyboard and on phones. A list view of the same items is planned for My Career; until then every card is reachable by Tab.
Lines aren't focusable. Legend entries are buttons (aria-pressed) that select the same route, so keyboard and screen-reader users can do everything a pointer can.

constraints: Use only for an employee's career plan — role cards connected by moves. For an ordered, admin-edited path use career-path-stepper.
Pass items and links only; the component lays cards out left to right from the links. Never pass coordinates.
Exactly one card should be in state current; at most one in state target.
The map is read-only: no dragging, connecting or deleting. Plan changes happen through Preview → Confirm outside the map.
Give the map a height from its container (it fills 100%).
Use item.label only to number or name a state ("Career vision 2"); the state still sets the icon and colour.
Put page actions for the map (a path picker, Explore a role) in the toolbar slot — top-left, clear of the zoom controls.
Give cards a lane to put a sequence on one row (lane 0 = top) and branches on rows below; without lanes, cards are centred per column.
Use state completed for levels already passed on the followed path; it has no actions.
Every link names its route (a CareerMapPath id). Company paths are solid; routes with kind "vision" are dashed violet.
Mark exactly one company path followed — it's drawn green; every other company path is grey. Name routes in CareerMapLegend with the same list.
Pass onSelectRoute to both the map and the legend: lines are clicked with a pointer, legend entries are the keyboard way to select a route.
Selecting a card and selecting a route are exclusive — clear one when the other is set.
Pass onPaneClick to let a click on empty canvas clear the consumer's selection (a drag to pan never counts as a click).

doNot.wrong: Show progress or gap numbers on the cards
doNot.correct: Keep cards to state, Position and level; show progress and gaps in the page, fixed to the Active target

doNot.wrong: Use brand or blue for a company path line
doNot.correct: Use career-map/followed-edge for the followed path and career-map/other-path-edge for every other — brand means selected / primary and blue means info

doNot.wrong: Open the map zoomed out until text is unreadable
doNot.correct: Let the component choose the opening view; offer Show whole map for the overview
Use the built-in zoom and Show whole map buttons

doNot.wrong: Tell a Career vision apart by colour only
doNot.correct: Give its route kind "vision" so lines and card borders are dashed as well as violet
Use the vision route (violet) — red means error in Enpath and would read as "not allowed"

doNot.wrong: Dim the other cards when a route is selected
doNot.correct: Ring the route's cards and thicken its lines; other routes switch to their -inactive colour token. Never dim cards, lines or text with opacity
Inactive entries use color/text/secondary; the active entry is SemiBold foreground on the ghost hover fill

doNot.wrong: Ring completed cards when their route is selected
doNot.correct: Completed cards never get the route ring and grey their level — the past recedes

doNot.wrong: Give each company path its own colour
doNot.correct: Colour says the route's role — followed (green), other company path (grey), Career vision (violet). The legend names routes; a colour per path runs out and changes when the employee follows another path
Use the role's -inactive token (followed-edge-inactive, other-path-edge-inactive, vision-edge-inactive)

doNot.wrong: List every company path in the legend
doNot.correct: Pass only routes drawn on the map; other company paths reach the map through Explore a position

subComponents.name: career-map-legend
subComponents.role: Names each company path colour and the dashed Career vision
subComponents.overrideRule: Pass the same paths as the map

relatedComponents.name: career-path-stepper
relatedComponents.reason: Both show career moves; the stepper is an ordered admin list, the map is an employee's branching plan.

openQuestions: List view fallback for keyboard and mobile is not built yet.
How to show many company paths at once (legend grouping, show only followed + selected) — open in what should be done.md.
notes: Built on React Flow (@xyflow/react, MIT). Layout constants (card 176×104, column gap 48, row gap 32) are canvas coordinates, not CSS spacing.
knownIssues: Card white vs canvas is 1.19:1 — the card edge relies on shadow/surface.

changelog.change: Created Career Map, Career Map Legend and the career-map component-token collection for My Career.
Added item.label (e.g. "Career vision 2") and a toolbar slot; the view re-fits when cards are added or removed.
Added the completed state and item.lane (rows); cards 176px wide, column gap 48; opening view's readable minimum 70% so a 4-level path fits one row on a laptop.

Breaking: links take a required `route` (replaces optional pathId); visions are routes with kind "vision" (violet, dashed); `followed` path drawn green; route selection (selectedRoute / onSelectRoute) with rings; legend entries become buttons; `showVision` removed from the legend.

Breaking: removed the wide-grid token (the canvas is now one dot grid, career-map/grid). Canvas → brand/100, grid → brand/200, vision-border → violet/600, followed-edge → green/700. Cards get shadow/surface; the selected target's ring sits flush with its green border. Inactive routes' lines and legend swatches fade via new career-map/edge-inactive-opacity (opacity/40); with nothing selected the followed path counts as active. Legend labels no longer use opacity.

Card redesign (option C): the state label moves into a tinted status band across the top (career-map/band-completed · current · target · planned · vision); the level is now the card's title (text-base SemiBold) and the Position sits under it in small secondary text, because the level is what changes along a path. Completed cards grey their level. Card size unchanged (176×104).

Audit fixes: career-map/edge-inactive-opacity → opacity/60 (40% made vision lines unreadable); arrowheads fixed at ~10px in screen units instead of scaling with stroke width; completed cards skip the route ring; dot grid → brand/300 at 1.5px; zoom controls use Button size icon to match the toolbar height.
Added onPaneClick (click on empty canvas, not a drag). career-map/band-current → brand/100 → brand/200 so the You are here band doesn't match the brand/100 canvas (label 4.8:1).
Hid React Flow's attribution badge (proOptions.hideAttribution — allowed under its MIT licence).

Breaking: route colour is by role, not per path. Removed path-1..3 and the inactive-opacity token; CareerMapPath loses `color`. Added other-path-edge (zinc/600) for every non-followed company path, and -inactive tokens for each role (followed-edge-inactive green/400, other-path-edge-inactive zinc/400, vision-edge-inactive violet/400). routeColor(path, active) picks the token; no opacity anywhere.

CareerMapLegend entries are outline buttons (size sm) instead of ghost xs; the active route gets the outline pressed fill + SemiBold; swatches 20×3px in the role colour. The legend names only routes drawn on the map.

notes: Controlled selection: pass selectedId and onSelect; click, Enter and Space all report through onSelect.
Opening view is computed from the layout (fixed card sizes) with setViewport — not fitView, whose options React Flow overwrites from props before cards are measured.

docs.intro:
# Career Map

A read-only canvas of an employee's career plan — role cards joined by colour-coded company Career Path lines and dashed Career vision lines, laid out left to right.

---

sections.title: Structure
sections.body:
```
CareerMap — group, fills its container; fill: career-map/canvas
├─ grid — dot pattern: career-map/grid
├─ toolbar — optional consumer slot, top-left; inset spacing/component/md, gap spacing/component/xs
├─ controls — top-right; inset spacing/component/md, gap spacing/component/xs
│  └─ Button ×3 (size icon) — Zoom out · Zoom in · Show whole map
├─ CareerMapNode ×n — one per item, 176×104, shadow/surface; title wraps to 2 lines
│  ├─ status band — full width, tinted per state; icon + text (Completed · You are here · Active target · Planned · Career vision)
│  ├─ level — the card's title, "L2 · Mid" (secondary when completed)
│  └─ Position — small secondary text, up to 2 lines
└─ connection ×n — curved line + ~10px arrowhead in its route's role colour (followed = green, other company paths = grey, vision = dashed violet); the active route is thicker in the strong shade, others use the light (-inactive) shade
CareerMapLegend — list below the map, one outline button per route drawn on the map (plain entries without onSelectRoute)
```

---

sections.title: Behavior
sections.body:
Read-only: cards can't be dragged, connected or deleted. Clicking a line calls `onSelectRoute(routeId)`; the consumer controls `selectedRoute` — its lines thicken and its cards get a ring in the route's colour (completed cards excepted), while other routes' lines, arrows and legend swatches switch to their role's -inactive token (no opacity); with no route selected, the followed path is the active one (for a Career vision, only the roles in it, not the card it branches from). Click, Enter or Space on a card calls `onSelect(id)`; the consumer controls `selectedId`. Clicking empty canvas calls `onPaneClick()` — dragging to pan doesn't. Cards are placed in columns by the longest chain of links reaching them. Rows come from each card's `lane` (0 = top; a taken spot pushes the card down); cards without a lane are centred per column.

Opening view: the whole map if it fits at 70% zoom or more, otherwise the current role and its next steps. The view re-fits the same way whenever cards are added or removed (not on selection); when cards are added and the whole map isn't readable, it moves to the new cards and the card they start from. Fitting keeps the top strip of the canvas clear for the toolbar and zoom controls. Zoom buttons step in and out; Show whole map zooms out to everything (down to 40%). Drag to pan; pinch to zoom; mouse-wheel scroll is left to the page.

---
